subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should the two SSRF/proxy helpers become public Plugin SDK exports, or should packaged Browser/Ollama lazy loading be repaired through the existing owner-scoped private helper path?
rationale: The code clearly reproduces the package-subpath bug, but this PR resolves it by changing a security-sensitive SDK boundary that current comments, docs, and tests intentionally keep private.

options.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Boundary
options.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing private alias or staging path, with packaged lazy-load smoke proof.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Allow the helpers to become public only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs, API metadata, replacement guardrails, and release-note context.

options.title: Pick A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers choose a sibling branch or a new maintainer branch as the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing private alias or staging path, with packaged lazy-load smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about package/export and private SDK boundary policy, where this history points most strongly to steipete.
